adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the `addMembers` action contains an explicit `// TODO: should clear the input` and then calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` without ever resetting `this.set("usernames", ...)`. Since the template binds `{{user-selector usernames=usernames ...}}`, the selector will retain the previous usernames after adding. This is a real, diff-grounded UX/incompletion issue, but the diff does not prove it causes functional breakage (e.g., duplicate membership) because server-side `group.add(user)` behavior on existing members isn’t shown here.
